prompt:
# Debugging evidence trail

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: explain the debugging flow entirely through branch density, color, filtering, and character focus. All surfaces must be blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Octocat/Invertocat silhouette, wordmark, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, captions, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a cinematic 2.5D animated-film still with a cel-shaded developer, GitHub dark-mode depth, contribution-grid texture, repository branch traces, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, and restrained depth. Use approximately 80% near-black or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple, with one very small amber failure accent.

Show one developer methodically narrowing a tangled failed agent run into a minimal reproducible case. Visualize five differently shaped evidence streams as layered branch traces that progressively simplify through a physical funnel into one small verified cause marked only by a green focus ring. The visual POV is calm GitHub-style debugging: shrink the graph, inspect evidence, and isolate one cause before changing architecture.

Place the evidence scene on the right and preserve the left 42% for slide copy. No logos, mascots, generic analytics dashboard, words, letters, fake product UI, screenshots, interface panels, or watermarks.
